candidate_concepts.scene: A coastal ferry terminal after a snow squall; a woman on the sheltered boarding threshold pauses over a small crate of winter greenhouse cuttings while watching the newly lit boarding lamp.
A mountain cable-car station during the last departure; a woman carrying a violin case has just stepped into the warm vestibule and turns toward the closing loading platform.
The service entrance of a glass botanical conservatory at blue hour; a woman pauses at the warm door after bringing frost-covered citrus crates, checking the handwritten delivery tag.
A snow-dusted outdoor cinema courtyard after a power interruption; a projectionist in winter layers pauses beside the open equipment hut with a rolled screen cable, the projector lamp just restored.
A small rail platform where a flower seller protects paper-wrapped winter branches beside a bench as the delayed train headlamp first appears beyond the snowy switch.
A municipal ice-rink service gate at dusk; a rink worker pauses with a replacement bulb box beside a relit amber entrance lamp as skaters begin gathering beyond the gate.

selected_concept.scene: A coastal ferry terminal after a snow squall; a woman on the sheltered boarding threshold pauses over a small crate of winter greenhouse cuttings while watching the newly lit boarding lamp.

wardrobe_direction: A dark navy wool duffle coat with a cream pile-trimmed hood and cuffs, three wooden toggle-and-rope-loop closures, over a separate ochre quilted sleeveless vest and a cream ribbed roll-neck sweater. Open lower front separates the layers; broad foreground coat structure stays readable.
reference_observations: Visible dark chin-length bob, wispy bangs, soft oval face, dark eyes and small pink lips used only as face/hair appearance guidance; reference outfit and crop are not copied; no exact same-person guarantee.
artistic_comparison: Coastal or transit scenes make cold exterior versus a warm threshold visible, while an indoor garment display would lose the reason for the layers. All variants preserve a modestly attractive, self-possessed presence at saved sensual 1 and a restrained near-direction invention at creativity 1. The selected site gives a practical pause and a readable outer-to-inner clothing arrangement.
testcase_objectives: Observe toggle closure as wooden rod crossing a rope loop attached to opposite coat fronts
Observe hood pile trim attached along the same outer-coat hood edge
Observe sleeve-cuff pile trim attached to coat cuffs rather than sweater
Observe independently bounded ochre quilted vest inside the navy coat
Observe cream ribbed roll-neck sweater below the vest, with a collar separate from outer hood
Observe coat structure and the lower open front jointly without losing the garment ownership relations
precore_observation_policy: Every condition is agent-owned test design. Exact runtime gates will be the effective audited pack opt-in contracts; absent or occluded connections are fail.
